mentions.name: Personal static site generator
mentions.description: A self-built static site generator the author eventually wants to move their personal blog onto, built as a personal project; it includes custom code that generates infinitely nestable layouts.
mentions.audience: The author themself, as a personal project they plan to move their own blog to.
mentions.source_excerpt: And sort of in that same vein, I've been developing my own static site generator that I eventually want to move my blog to. It's almost certainly going to be a worse SSG than every alternative, but it'll be mine and that's worth something in itself.
